question: Select the figure from the options that can replace the question mark (?) and complete the given pattern. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f18fa25aba89d65aade684d2594c358edb5095fe73484aed48c8303adbb269c5.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For 1st box → From the given word "SLATED" :

 
• First and third letter interchanged positions.
 
• Fourth and sixth letter interchanged positions. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43132c542fee43f92b0ad6b8e31b9dc4fd8099b16f6a24c1b7937fd4bc4de99c.png] 

2) For 2nd box →

 
• First and sixth letter interchanged positions.
 
• Second, third, fourth and fifth letters shifted one step in the forward direction. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4277b43079158960eccc414dcdafef719a4cd89d5792caafbf14c1e53ba337b.png] 

 

3) For 3rd box → Same as in 1st box. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/852b78b582039dda54038e156f2f7686491ffc16e18b78df33238166b54e767b.png] 

4) For 4th box → Same as in 2nd box. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36d59d3b97369f8fea9c9970e1e13f2f9c235f0f028242d7fc6e56778a307f01.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80f3ff267f7bbc95105371ddc0458a3ed4802589b2d6c0cd1c0e1c53b140ed4a.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
